newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volume rises, Unibanka at new high.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volume rises, Unibanka at new high.

text.p: Share trade on the Latvian stock market leapt on Tuesday and leading bank Unibanka reached a new high, the Riga Stock Exchange said.
Overall turnover was 176,968 lats after 76,074 lats on Thursday and Unibanka rose to 2.03 lats from 1.96 lats amid trade of 139,093 lats.
Most of the market's shares were also actively traded, in what was one of best sessions for several weeks.
Riga Transport Fleet, the other share on the official list, turned over 9,520 lats and its price was stable at 85 santimes.
On the secondary list, fish cannery Kaija was as usual the most active.
It saw activity of 15,154 lats and its price was also steady at 57 santimes.
The Riga Yeast factory was active at trade of 5,976 lats and its price rose to 83 santimes from 73 santimes.
The Mangali Shipyard turned over 2,779 lats of stock and rose one santime to 28 santimes.
Other shares including the LMH agricultural equipment maker, the Latvian Bridges construction firm and the Daugavpils chain maket all turned over more than 1,000 lats.
